svg.text: LAUNCH FILM · STORYBOARD V4 · NIGHT GLASS CUT

g.text: Every frame, before it reaches you
V4 · SHOT 09 — WATCHED BY A PERSON

svg.text: A glass review card: the finished Panama Canal edit in a player, a teal scan line
sweeping across it, and the review checklist beneath (names, places, numbers, start to
finish). Reviewer chip: "Watched by Maya K."
Card re-forms from the answer card (shape morph: width/height animate, content
cross-fades, 0.4 s). Scan line passes top → bottom once per second; checks tick on in
Card collapses into a compact "Delivered" notification.

g.text: Why the Panama Canal ran short of water

svg.text: A compact glass notification: green check orb, "Delivered · Day 3", the video title
and its thumbnail. Under it, nine glass language chips light up one after another.
Notification drops 30 px and settles (overshoot); check draws on; chips pop left →
right 50 ms apart. Sparkles twinkle at the card corners.
Warm two-note "done" chime; nine light ticks.
Everything clears except the beam; a single glass card descends.
A single portrait glass card under the beam: a glowing play-icon orb, "Explainers",
Card descends 60 px out of the beam and rotates 0° (stays flat); light rakes across
The card has split: "AI b-roll" and "UGC ads" slide out from behind "Explainers",
Side cards slide out 300 px with 0.08 s offset, scaling 90 → 95%. Ref 0:13.4–0:14.
More cards join; the row bends into a carousel.
